overview: Exam Flashcard Prompts is a digital prompt pack designed for high school and college students drowning in dense study notes. It provides 35 plug-and-play AI prompts that instantly convert your raw lecture notes, textbook chapters, and PDFs into focused, high-yield flashcard decks.
usecases: Pasting 50 pages of biology lecture notes into ChatGPT to generate instant, conceptual flashcards before an exam.
Breaking down complex legal or historical frameworks into bite-sized active-recall questions when you're too burnt out to write cards manually.
Organizing your digital flashcard software with built-in spaced repetition metadata without wasting hours formatting tags.
howto: Download the prompt pack instantly after purchase as a clean PDF and Notion template.
Copy any of the 35 subject-agnostic prompts into your AI tool of choice alongside your study notes.
Export the generated Q&A pairs directly into your preferred flashcard app and start studying.

faq.q: Will I still have to do the work of making the cards?
faq.a: No, the prompts handle 90% of the heavy lifting by extracting key concepts and phrasing them as active-recall questions, though you will need to review and copy them into your study app.

faq.q: Do I need a paid subscription to an AI tool to use these?
faq.a: No, these prompts are fully optimized and tested to work exceptionally well on free AI models like ChatGPT and Claude.
